subject: Intro + MAP kickoff — EmberHealth x Redwood (exec sponsor, escalation, Q3 outcomes)
messages:
From: Lisa Wong <lisa.wong@emberhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.su@emberhealth.com, procurement@emberhealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + MAP kickoff: EmberHealth & Redwood

Hi Hannah (and Marissa),

Thanks for the demos last week — really appreciated the concise throughput/cost data you shared. I'm Lisa, CTO at EmberHealth. We're looking to validate Redwood in our inference stack for an initial pilot (patient-facing summarization + analytics) and want to run a short MAP to track decisions, procurement milestones, and exec-level outcomes.

High-level outcomes we care about by end of Q3:
- 95th-percentile token latency under 350ms for 8k-context runs in staging
- Cost per 1k tokens reduced by 20% vs current baseline in piloted flow
- Data controls in place (audit logs, KMS integration) for PHI-classified payloads

Our timeline is tight: technical evaluation in August, procurement & legal in September, production pilot by October 1. I want to be the exec sponsor for EmberHealth — I'll own the decision on run criteria and risk acceptance.

Please nominate your exec sponsor and share a one-page MAP with roles, milestones, and escalation contacts so we can schedule a kickoff this week. Also loop in procurement contact (Tom Su) for contract timing.

Thanks,
Lisa Wong
CTO, EmberHealth

Attachments: none
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Wong <lisa.wong@emberhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, tom.su@emberhealth.com, procurement@emberhealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP kickoff: EmberHealth & Redwood

Hi Lisa — great to meet you and thanks for the clear outcomes. Excited to run this with EmberHealth.

Quick replies to your asks:
- Exec sponsor (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra, VP of Product Engineering (rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai). He will own escalation and the final technical sign-off.
- MAP draft: attached "Redwood_MAP_v0.1.pdf" — one page with milestones, owners, and success criteria.
- Proposed kickoff windows (30–45 min): Tue 2026-08-03 11:00-11:45 PT or Wed 2026-08-04 08:30-09:15 PT. Please confirm which works.

High-level owners (proposed):
- Redwood AE / deal lead: Hannah Schmitt (me) — overall MAP coordination, timeline, and commercial touchpoints
- Redwood Solutions Eng: Neha Kapoor — technical onboarding, test harness, and staging validation
- Redwood CS/Onboarding: Sean Gallagher — pilot runbooks and run-of production readiness checks
- Exec sponsor (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra — escalation / sign-off

I'll also add Marissa (sales ops) on procurement/legal cadence and pricing.

Next steps: please confirm kickoff time and we'll circulate an agenda + MAP in HubSpot.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Intro + MAP kickoff: EmberHealth & Redwood

Lisa / team — thanks for the clear objectives. I can serve as Redwood's exec sponsor. A couple quick notes on escalation & outcomes: 

Escalation path (primary -> secondary):
1) Hannah Schmitt (AE) — day-to-day MAP progress and blocker triage
2) Neha Kapoor (Solutions Eng) — technical triage for staging/perf issues
3) Sean Gallagher (CS) — onboarding/runbook gaps that affect pilot schedule
4) Rishi Malhotra (VP Product Eng) — exec escalations, budget/contract exceptions

Executive outcomes we'll use to validate success at end of Q3:
- Performance: 95th percentile token latency <350ms on representative sample (test harness will be provided)
- Cost: unit cost reduction target >=20% vs Ember baseline for pilot traffic shape
- Controls: KMS integration + audit log retention policy documented and accepted by security

I've attached a short escalation playbook and my mobile for immediate reach. If anything looks off, reply-all and we'll adjust.

Rishi
VP, Product Engineering — Redwood Inference

2) Legal contact or DocuSign link when you have a PO / order form ready — target to complete signature by mid-Sep (we need this for budgeting cycles).

We have a short procurement checklist attached (for visibility). Also please include any SOC2 evidence pointers and data retention settings in the MAP or follow-up.

Tom Su

I'll circulate updated MAP v0.2 after the call with the timeline adjusted per procurement's input. HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/EMB-2026-045 (will attach MAP and notes).

Thanks all — talk soon.

Best,
Hannah
